706 /-- An injective continuous map pulls back point-separating real functions. -/
707 theorem RealSeparatesPoints.of_injective_continuous
708     {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
709     (h : RealSeparatesPoints Y) {f : X → Y} (hi : Function.Injective f) (hc : Continuous f) :
710     RealSeparatesPoints X := by
711   intro x y hxy
712   obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h (f x) (f y) (hi.ne hxy)
713   exact ⟨p.comp ⟨f, hc⟩, hp⟩
714 
715 variable {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
716 
717 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
718 /-- Each skeleton inherits point separation from the initial subspace. -/
719 theorem RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.skeleton_realSeparatesPoints
720     {A B : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} {i : A ⟶ B} (c : RelativeEquivariantCWComplex i)
721     (hA : RealSeparatesPoints A.V) (n : ℕ) : RealSeparatesPoints (c.F.obj n).V := by
722   induction n with
723   | zero =>
724     let e := TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Action.forget TopCat Γ).mapIso c.isoBot)
725     exact hA.of_injective_continuous e.injective e.continuous
726   | succ n hn => exact orbitCellAttachment_realSeparatesPoints (c.attachment n) hn
727 
728 /-- Point-separating real functions on the skeleta extend to the final relative CW space. -/
729 theorem RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.realSeparatesPoints
730     {A B : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} {i : A ⟶ B} (c : RelativeEquivariantCWComplex i)
731     (hA : RealSeparatesPoints A.V) : RealSeparatesPoints B.V := by
732   intro x y hxy
733   obtain ⟨m, xm, hxm⟩ := c.exists_skeleton_preimage x
734   obtain ⟨n, yn, hyn⟩ := c.exists_skeleton_preimage y
735   let k := max m n
736   let xk := (c.F.map (homOfLE (le_max_left m n))).hom xm
737   let yk := (c.F.map (homOfLE (le_max_right m n))).hom yn
738   have hx : (c.incl.app k).hom xk = x := by
739     have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
740       (congrArg Action.Hom.hom (c.incl.naturality (homOfLE (le_max_left m n)))) xm
741     exact h.trans hxm
742   have hy : (c.incl.app k).hom yk = y := by
743     have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
744       (congrArg Action.Hom.hom (c.incl.naturality (homOfLE (le_max_right m n)))) yn
745     exact h.trans hyn
746   have hne : xk ≠ yk := fun h => hxy (hx.symm.trans ((congrArg (c.incl.app k).hom h).trans hy))
747   obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := c.skeleton_realSeparatesPoints hA k xk yk hne
748   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := c.skeleton_extend_real k p
749   refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
750   rw [← hx, ← hy, hF, hF]
751   exact hp
752 
753 /-- Absolute equivariant CW spaces have enough continuous real functions to separate points. -/
754 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.realSeparatesPoints
755     {A : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} (c : EquivariantCWComplex A) : RealSeparatesPoints A.V := by
756   apply RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.realSeparatesPoints c
757   have hinit := initialIsInitial.isInitialObj (underlyingAction (Γ := Γ))
758   let : IsEmpty ((⊥_ (Action TopCat.{u} Γ)).V) :=
759     (Types.initial_iff_empty _).mp ⟨hinit⟩
760   intro x
761   exact isEmptyElim x
762 
763 /-- Hausdorffness follows from the categorical equivariant CW data, without an extra premise. -/
764 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.t2Space
765     {A : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} (c : EquivariantCWComplex A) : T2Space A.V :=
766   c.realSeparatesPoints.t2Space
767

774 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
775 variable {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
776 
777 private def emptyCofan {C : Type*} [Category C] [HasInitial C] (F : PEmpty.{u+1} → C) :
778     Cofan F := Cofan.mk (⊥_ C) (fun j => j.elim)
779 
780 private def emptyCofanColimit {C : Type*} [Category C] [HasInitial C] (F : PEmpty.{u+1} → C) :
781     IsColimit (emptyCofan F) :=
782   Cofan.IsColimit.mk _ (fun s => initial.to s.pt) (fun _ j => j.elim)
783     (fun _ _ _ => initialIsInitial.hom_ext _ _)
784 
785 /-- Attaching no cells realizes the identity, in any dimension. -/
786 def identityCellAttachment (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) (n : ℕ) :
787     HomotopicalAlgebra.AttachCells.{u} (equivariantBasicCell (Γ := Γ) n) (𝟙 X) where
788   ι := PEmpty
789   π := PEmpty.elim
790   cofan₁ := emptyCofan _
791   cofan₂ := emptyCofan _
792   isColimit₁ := emptyCofanColimit _
793   isColimit₂ := emptyCofanColimit _
794   m := 𝟙 _
795   hm j := j.elim
796   g₁ := initial.to X
797   g₂ := initial.to X
798   isPushout := IsPushout.of_id_snd
799 
800 private abbrev zeroSkeletonObj (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) : ℕ → Action TopCat.{u} Γ
801   | 0 => ⊥_ _
802   | _ + 1 => X
803 
804 private abbrev zeroSkeletonMap (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) :
805     (n : ℕ) → zeroSkeletonObj X n ⟶ zeroSkeletonObj X (n+1)
806   | 0 => initial.to X
807   | _ + 1 => 𝟙 X
808 
809 private abbrev zeroSkeletonSequence (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) : ℕ ⥤ Action TopCat.{u} Γ :=
810   Functor.ofSequence (zeroSkeletonMap X)
811 
812 private def zeroSkeletonInclusion (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) :
813     zeroSkeletonSequence X ⟶ (Functor.const ℕ).obj X :=
814   NatTrans.ofSequence (fun n => match n with | 0 => initial.to X | _+1 => 𝟙 X)
815     (fun n => by
816       cases n with
817       | zero => change initial.to X ≫ 𝟙 X = initial.to X ≫ 𝟙 X; rfl
818       | succ n =>
819         simp only [zeroSkeletonSequence, Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ]
820         rfl)
821 
822 private def zeroSkeletonColimit (X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) :
823     IsColimit (Cocone.mk X (zeroSkeletonInclusion X)) where
824   desc s := s.ι.app 1
825   fac s n := by
826     cases n with
827     | zero => exact initialIsInitial.hom_ext _ _
828     | succ n =>
829       change 𝟙 X ≫ s.ι.app 1 = s.ι.app (n+1)
830       simp only [Category.id_comp]
831       induction n with
832       | zero => rfl
833       | succ n hn =>
834         have h := s.w (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ (n+1)))
835         simp only [zeroSkeletonSequence, Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ,
836           zeroSkeletonMap] at h
837         exact hn.trans h.symm
838   uniq s m h := by
839     have hh := h 1
840     change 𝟙 X ≫ m = s.ι.app 1 at hh
841     exact (Category.id_comp m).symm.trans hh
842 
843 /-- A zero-cell attachment from the empty action extends to a genuine CW structure
844 by taking a constant tail and attaching no higher-dimensional cells. -/
845 def EquivariantCWComplex.ofZeroAttachment {X : Action TopCat.{u} Γ}
846     (c : HomotopicalAlgebra.AttachCells.{u} (equivariantBasicCell (Γ := Γ) 0)
847       (initial.to X)) : EquivariantCWComplex X where
848   F := zeroSkeletonSequence X
849   isoBot := Iso.refl _
850   incl := zeroSkeletonInclusion X
851   isColimit := zeroSkeletonColimit X
852   fac := initialIsInitial.hom_ext _ _
853   attachCells n _ := by
854     cases n with
855     | zero => simpa only [zeroSkeletonSequence, Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ,
856         zeroSkeletonMap] using c
857     | succ n => simpa only [zeroSkeletonSequence, Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ,
858         zeroSkeletonMap] using identityCellAttachment X (n+1)
859 
860 end BC4lean.ProperActions

865 private instance diskZeroSubsingleton : Subsingleton (TopCat.disk.{u} 0) := by
866   change Subsingleton (ULift (Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0)) 1))
867   infer_instance
868 
869 private instance diskZeroDiscrete : DiscreteTopology (TopCat.disk.{u} 0) := inferInstance
870 
871 private instance boundaryZeroEmpty : IsEmpty (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} 0) := by
872   constructor
873   intro x
874   have h := x.down.property
875   have hx : x.down.val = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
876   simp [hx] at h

878 /-- A disjoint union of zero-dimensional orbit cells. -/
879 def OrbitZeroSkeleton {ι : Type u} (p : ι → FiniteIsotropy Γ) :=
880   Σ i, OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0)
881 
882 namespace OrbitZeroSkeleton
883 variable {ι : Type u} (p : ι → FiniteIsotropy Γ)
884 instance : TopologicalSpace (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) :=
885   inferInstanceAs (TopologicalSpace (Σ i, OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0)))
886 instance : DiscreteTopology (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) := by
887   change DiscreteTopology (Σ i, OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
888   let (i : ι) : DiscreteTopology (Γ ⧸ (p i).val) := QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (isOpen_discrete _)
889   let (i : ι) : DiscreteTopology (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0)) :=
890     inferInstanceAs (DiscreteTopology ((Γ ⧸ (p i).val) × TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
891   infer_instance
892 instance : MulAction Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) where
893   smul g x := ⟨x.1, g • x.2⟩
894   one_smul x := congrArg (Sigma.mk x.1) (one_smul Γ x.2)
895   mul_smul g h x := congrArg (Sigma.mk x.1) (mul_smul g h x.2)
896 instance : ContinuousConstSMul Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) := ⟨fun _ => continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
897 
898 /-- The inclusion of one orbit zero-cell. -/
899 def inclusion (i : ι) : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
900     (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) where
901   toFun x := ⟨i,x⟩
902   continuous_toFun := by
903     exact @continuous_sigmaMk ι (fun j => OrbitCell (p j).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
904       (fun j => inferInstance) i
905   map_smul' _ _ := rfl
906 
907 private def cellCofan : Cofan (fun i => topologicalAction Γ
908     (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))) :=
909   Cofan.mk (topologicalAction Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p)) (fun i => (inclusion p i).toActionHom)
910 
911 private def cellCofanColimit : IsColimit (cellCofan p) := by
912   refine Cofan.IsColimit.mk (cellCofan p) (fun s => ?_) ?_ ?_
913   · change topologicalAction Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) ⟶ s.pt
914     exact {
915       hom := TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => (s.inj x.1).hom x.2,
916         continuous_sigma (fun i => (s.inj i).hom.hom.continuous)⟩
917       comm := fun g => by
918         apply TopCat.hom_ext
919         apply ContinuousMap.ext
920         intro x
921         exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (s.inj x.1 |>.comm g) x.2 }
922   · intro s i
923     rfl
924   · intro s m hm
925     apply Action.Hom.ext
926     apply TopCat.hom_ext
927     apply ContinuousMap.ext
928     intro ⟨i,x⟩
929     exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg Action.Hom.hom (hm i)) x
930 
931 private def boundaryInitial (i : ι) : IsInitial (topologicalAction Γ
932     (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} 0))) := by
933   let h (Y : Action TopCat.{u} Γ) : Unique
934       (topologicalAction Γ (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} 0)) ⟶ Y) :=
935     { default :=
936         { hom := TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => isEmptyElim x.2, by fun_prop⟩
937           comm := fun _ => by ext x; exact isEmptyElim x.2 }
938       uniq := fun f => by ext x; exact isEmptyElim x.2 }
939   exact IsInitial.ofUnique _
940 
941 private def boundaryCofan : Cofan (fun i => topologicalAction Γ
942     (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} 0))) :=
943   Cofan.mk (⊥_ _) (fun i => (boundaryInitial p i).to _)
944 
945 private def boundaryCofanColimit : IsColimit (boundaryCofan p) :=
946   Cofan.IsColimit.mk _ (fun s => initial.to s.pt)
947     (fun _ i => (boundaryInitial p i).hom_ext _ _)
948     (fun _ _ _ => initialIsInitial.hom_ext _ _)
949 
950 /-- Construct the zero-cell attachment with explicit coproduct and pushout witnesses. -/
951 def attachment : HomotopicalAlgebra.AttachCells.{u} (equivariantBasicCell (Γ := Γ) 0)
952     (initial.to (topologicalAction Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p))) where
953   ι := ι
954   π := p
955   cofan₁ := boundaryCofan p
956   cofan₂ := cellCofan p
957   isColimit₁ := boundaryCofanColimit p
958   isColimit₂ := cellCofanColimit p
959   m := initial.to _
960   hm i := (boundaryInitial p i).hom_ext _ _
961   g₁ := 𝟙 _
962   g₂ := 𝟙 _
963   isPushout := IsPushout.of_id_fst
964 
965 /-- A disjoint union of finite-isotropy orbit zero-cells has a genuine equivariant CW structure. -/
966 def cwComplex : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ (OrbitZeroSkeleton p)) :=
967   .ofZeroAttachment (attachment p)
968 
969 end OrbitZeroSkeleton
970 end BC4lean.ProperActions
971 
972 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
973 variable {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
974 
975 omit [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
976 /-- A countable group has only countably many finite subgroups. -/
977 theorem finiteIsotropy_countable [Countable Γ] : Countable (FiniteIsotropy Γ) := by
978   classical
979   have hf (H : FiniteIsotropy Γ) : (H.val : Set Γ).Finite := by
980     let := H.property
981     exact Set.toFinite _
982   let f : FiniteIsotropy Γ → Finset Γ := fun H => (hf H).toFinset
983   have hi : Function.Injective f := by
984     intro H K h
985     apply Subtype.ext
986     apply SetLike.coe_injective
987     have hh := congrArg (fun s : Finset Γ => (s : Set Γ)) h
988     simpa only [f, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using hh
989   exact hi.countable
990 
991 namespace OrbitZeroSkeleton
992 variable {ι : Type u} (p : ι → FiniteIsotropy Γ)
993 
994 omit [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
995 /-- Countably many zero-cell orbits for a countable group give a countable space. -/
996 theorem countable [Countable Γ] [Countable ι] : Countable (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) := by
997   change Countable (Σ i, OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
998   let (i : ι) : Countable (Γ ⧸ (p i).val) :=
999     (QuotientGroup.mk_surjective (s := (p i).val)).countable
1000   let : Countable (TopCat.disk.{u} 0) := inferInstance
1001   let (i : ι) : Countable (OrbitCell (p i).val (TopCat.disk.{u} 0)) :=
1002     inferInstanceAs (Countable ((Γ ⧸ (p i).val) × TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
1003   infer_instance
1004 
1005 /-- The constructed zero-skeleton is locally compact. -/
1006 theorem locallyCompact : LocallyCompactSpace (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) := inferInstance
1007 
1008 /-- Under countability assumptions the constructed zero-skeleton is second countable. -/
1009 theorem secondCountable [Countable Γ] [Countable ι] :
1010     SecondCountableTopology (OrbitZeroSkeleton p) := by
1011   let := countable p
1012   infer_instance
1013 end OrbitZeroSkeleton
1014 
1015 /-- The zero-skeleton containing one orbit Γ/H for every finite subgroup H. -/
1016 abbrev UniversalZeroSkeleton (Γ : Type u) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] :=
1017   OrbitZeroSkeleton (fun H : FiniteIsotropy Γ => H)
1018 
1019 namespace UniversalZeroSkeleton
1020 /-- An explicit finite-subgroup-fixed vertex in the universal zero-skeleton. -/
1021 def fixedVertex (H : Subgroup Γ) [Finite H] : FixedPointSpace H (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) := by
1022   let z : TopCat.disk.{u} 0 := ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩
1023   refine ⟨⟨⟨H,inferInstance⟩, (QuotientGroup.mk 1, z)⟩, ?_⟩
1024   intro h
1025   change (⟨⟨H,inferInstance⟩, ((h : Γ) • (QuotientGroup.mk 1 : Γ ⧸ H), z)⟩ :
1026     UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) = _
1027   rw [subgroup_fixes_identity_coset]
1028 
1029 /-- The universal zero-skeleton has a verified equivariant CW structure. -/
1030 def cwComplex : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ)) :=
1031   OrbitZeroSkeleton.cwComplex _
1032 
1033 omit [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
1034 /-- It is a countable space for a countable group. -/
1035 theorem countable [Countable Γ] : Countable (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) := by
1036   let := finiteIsotropy_countable (Γ := Γ)
1037   exact OrbitZeroSkeleton.countable _
1038 
1039 /-- The universal zero-skeleton is locally compact and second countable. -/
1040 theorem locallyCompact_secondCountable [Countable Γ] :
1041     LocallyCompactSpace (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) ∧ SecondCountableTopology (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) := by
1042   let := finiteIsotropy_countable (Γ := Γ)
1043   exact ⟨OrbitZeroSkeleton.locallyCompact _, OrbitZeroSkeleton.secondCountable _⟩
1044 end UniversalZeroSkeleton
1045 end BC4lean.ProperActions
1046 
1047 end

源码 SHA-256：4cb73c5c98de04a4e67abc1b32d8fbd511f8e27e615373a165014cdc4324f58d

  1 import BC4lean.EquivariantCW
  2 
  3 /-! # Maps from orbit cells and fixed-point extension problems
  4 
  5 Continuous equivariant maps Γ/H × D → X are continuous maps D → X^H.
  6 Consequently extension across a parameter map is exactly an ordinary extension
  7 problem in the fixed-point space. This does not assume or prove that those
  8 ordinary extensions exist for contractible targets.
  9 -/
 10 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 11 
 12 universe u v w
 13 
 14 variable {Γ : Type u} {D E : Type v} {X : Type w} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
 15 variable [TopologicalSpace D] [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X]
 16 variable [MulAction Γ X] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ X]
 17 
 18 /-- Evaluate an equivariant map on the identity-coset slice. -/
 19 def cellEvaluation (H : Subgroup Γ) (f : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H D) X) :
 20     C(D, FixedPointSpace H X) where
 21   toFun d := ⟨f (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d), fun h => by
 22     change (h : Γ) • f (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d) = f (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d)
 23     exact (f.map_smul (h : Γ) (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d)).symm.trans
 24       (congrArg f (Prod.ext (subgroup_fixes_identity_coset H h) rfl))⟩
 25   continuous_toFun :=
 26     (f.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).subtype_mk _
 27 
 28 /-- Extend a continuous family of fixed points equivariantly over the orbit factor. -/
 29 def cellFromFixed (H : Subgroup Γ) (u : C(D, FixedPointSpace H X)) :
 30     EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H D) X where
 31   toFun p := orbitMap H (u p.2) p.1
 32   continuous_toFun := by
 33     let : DiscreteTopology (Γ ⧸ H) := QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (isOpen_discrete _)
 34     change Continuous (fun p : (Γ ⧸ H) × D => orbitMap H (u p.2) p.1)
 35     apply continuous_prod_of_discrete_left.mpr
 36     intro q
 37     induction q using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
 38     | H g =>
 39       change Continuous (fun d => g • (u d : X))
 40       exact (continuous_const_smul g).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp u.continuous)
 41   map_smul' g p := (orbitMap H (u p.2)).map_smul g p.1
 42 
 43 /-- The orbit/fixed-point correspondence with a topological parameter. -/
 44 def orbitCellMapEquiv (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 45     EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H D) X ≃ C(D, FixedPointSpace H X) where
 46   toFun := cellEvaluation H
 47   invFun := cellFromFixed H
 48   left_inv f := by
 49     ext p
 50     rcases p with ⟨q, d⟩
 51     induction q using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
 52     | H g =>
 53       change g • f (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d) = f (QuotientGroup.mk g, d)
 54       apply (f.map_smul g (QuotientGroup.mk 1, d)).symm.trans
 55       apply congrArg f
 56       change (g • (QuotientGroup.mk 1 : Γ ⧸ H), d) = (QuotientGroup.mk g, d)
 57       simp only [MulAction.Quotient.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
 58   right_inv u := by
 59     ext d
 60     exact one_smul Γ (u d : X)
 61 
 62 omit [ContinuousConstSMul Γ X] [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
 63 /-- Evaluation commutes with restriction along any continuous parameter map. -/
 64 theorem cellEvaluation_comp (H : Subgroup Γ) (i : C(D, E))
 65     (f : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H E) X) :
 66     cellEvaluation H (f.comp (OrbitCell.map H i)) = (cellEvaluation H f).comp i := by
 67   ext d
 68   rfl
 69 
 70 /-- An equivariant cell extension exists exactly when its fixed-point slice extends. -/
 71 theorem orbitCell_extension_iff (H : Subgroup Γ) (i : C(D, E))
 72     (f : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H D) X) :
 73     (∃ F : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H E) X, F.comp (OrbitCell.map H i) = f) ↔
 74       ∃ u : C(E, FixedPointSpace H X), u.comp i = cellEvaluation H f := by
 75   constructor
 76   · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
 77     exact ⟨cellEvaluation H F, (cellEvaluation_comp H i F).symm.trans (congrArg (cellEvaluation H) hF)⟩
 78   · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
 79     refine ⟨cellFromFixed H u, ?_⟩
 80     apply (orbitCellMapEquiv H).injective
 81     change cellEvaluation H ((cellFromFixed H u).comp (OrbitCell.map H i)) = cellEvaluation H f
 82     rw [cellEvaluation_comp]
 83     have he : cellEvaluation H (cellFromFixed H u) = u := (orbitCellMapEquiv H).apply_symm_apply u
 84     rw [he, hu]
 85 
 86 end BC4lean.ProperActions

源码 SHA-256：57fde0d5e6c94ac4e1e1cc48174e410fd808f9332008ef5b682f8e58fa95efe3

  1 import Mathlib.Topology.Homotopy.Contractible
  2 import Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.Sphere
  3 
  4 /-!
  5 # Extension from the boundary of a disk
  6 
  7 A null-homotopic map from a unit sphere extends over the closed unit ball.
  8 The proof descends the null-homotopy through the radial quotient map.
  9 -/
 10 
 11 noncomputable section
 12 
 13 open Metric
 14 open scoped unitInterval
 15 
 16 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 17 
 18 universe u
 19 
 20 variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
 21 
 22 /-- Inclusion of the unit sphere into the closed unit ball. -/
 23 def sphereInclusion : C(sphere (0 : E) 1, closedBall (0 : E) 1) :=
 24   ⟨fun x => ⟨x.1, le_of_eq x.2⟩, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩
 25 
 26 /-- The radial map from the cylinder on the unit sphere to the unit ball. -/
 27 def radialMap : C(I × sphere (0 : E) 1, closedBall (0 : E) 1) := by
 28   refine ⟨fun p => ⟨(p.1 : ℝ) • p.2.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 29   · rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
 30       abs_of_nonneg p.1.2.1, norm_eq_of_mem_sphere, mul_one]
 31     exact p.1.2.2
 32   · exact ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
 33       (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).subtype_mk _
 34 
 35 /-- The radial coordinate is recovered by taking the norm. -/
 36 theorem radialMap_norm (p : I × sphere (0 : E) 1) :
 37     ‖(radialMap p : E)‖ = (p.1 : ℝ) := by
 38   have hs : ‖p.2.1‖ = 1 := by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using p.2.2
 39   simp [radialMap, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg p.1.2.1, hs]
 40 
 41 /-- If the sphere is nonempty, every point of the ball has radial coordinates. -/
 42 theorem radialMap_surjective [Nonempty (sphere (0 : E) 1)] :
 43     Function.Surjective (radialMap (E := E)) := by
 44   intro x
 45   by_cases hx : x.1 = 0
 46   · obtain ⟨s⟩ := ‹Nonempty (sphere (0 : E) 1)›
 47     exact ⟨(0, s), Subtype.ext (by simp [radialMap, hx])⟩
 48   · have hn : ‖x.1‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
 49     let s : sphere (0 : E) 1 := ⟨‖x.1‖⁻¹ • x.1, by
 50       simp [norm_smul, hn]⟩
 51     refine ⟨(⟨‖x.1‖, norm_nonneg _, by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using x.2⟩, s), ?_⟩
 52     apply Subtype.ext
 53     change ‖x.1‖ • (‖x.1‖⁻¹ • x.1) = x.1
 54     simp [smul_smul, hn]
 55 
 56 /-- The radial cylinder is a quotient presentation of the ball. -/
 57 theorem radialMap_isQuotientMap [ProperSpace E] [Nonempty (sphere (0 : E) 1)] :
 58     Topology.IsQuotientMap (radialMap (E := E)) :=
 59   .of_surjective_continuous radialMap_surjective radialMap.continuous
 60 
 61 variable {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
 62 
 63 /-- A homotopy starting at a constant is constant on the radial fibers. -/
 64 theorem homotopy_factorsThrough_radialMap {y : Y} {f : C(sphere (0 : E) 1, Y)}
 65     (H : (ContinuousMap.const _ y).Homotopy f) :
 66     Function.FactorsThrough H (radialMap (E := E)) := by
 67   intro p q hpq
 68   have ht : p.1 = q.1 := Subtype.ext (by
 69     simpa only [radialMap_norm] using congrArg (fun x : closedBall (0 : E) 1 => ‖x.1‖) hpq)
 70   by_cases hzero : p.1 = 0
 71   · have hzq : q.1 = 0 := ht.symm.trans hzero
 72     change H (p.1, p.2) = H (q.1, q.2)
 73     rw [hzero, hzq, H.apply_zero, H.apply_zero]
 74     rfl
 75   · have hn : (p.1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hzero (Subtype.ext h)
 76     have hs : p.2 = q.2 := by
 77       apply Subtype.ext
 78       have h := congrArg (fun x : closedBall (0 : E) 1 => x.1) hpq
 79       change (p.1 : ℝ) • p.2.1 = (q.1 : ℝ) • q.2.1 at h
 80       rw [← ht] at h
 81       exact (smul_right_injective E hn) h
 82     exact congrArg H (Prod.ext ht hs)
 83 
 84 /-- A null-homotopic sphere map extends over the closed ball. -/
 85 theorem nullhomotopic_extends_ball [ProperSpace E]
 86     (f : C(sphere (0 : E) 1, Y)) (hf : f.Nullhomotopic) :
 87     ∃ F : C(closedBall (0 : E) 1, Y), F.comp sphereInclusion = f := by
 88   classical
 89   obtain ⟨y, ⟨H⟩⟩ := hf
 90   cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (sphere (0 : E) 1) with
 91   | inl h =>
 92     exact ⟨ContinuousMap.const _ y, ContinuousMap.ext (fun x => isEmptyElim x)⟩
 93   | inr h =>
 94     let q := radialMap_isQuotientMap (E := E)
 95     let F := q.lift H.symm.toContinuousMap (homotopy_factorsThrough_radialMap H.symm)
 96     refine ⟨F, ContinuousMap.ext fun s => ?_⟩
 97     have h := ContinuousMap.congr_fun (q.lift_comp H.symm.toContinuousMap
 98       (homotopy_factorsThrough_radialMap H.symm)) (1, s)
 99     change F (radialMap (1, s)) = H.symm (1, s) at h
100     rw [H.symm.apply_one] at h
101     have he : radialMap (1, s) = sphereInclusion s := Subtype.ext (one_smul ℝ s.1)
102     rw [he] at h
103     exact h
104 
105 /-- Every sphere map into a contractible space extends over the ball. -/
106 theorem contractible_extends_ball [ProperSpace E] [ContractibleSpace Y]
107     (f : C(sphere (0 : E) 1, Y)) :
108     ∃ F : C(closedBall (0 : E) 1, Y), F.comp sphereInclusion = f := by
109   apply nullhomotopic_extends_ball f
110   simpa using (id_nullhomotopic Y).comp_left f
111 
112 /-- Every map from the boundary of a Euclidean disk into a contractible space extends. -/
113 theorem contractible_extends_disk {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [ContractibleSpace Y]
114     (n : ℕ) (f : C(TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n, Y)) :
115     ∃ F : C(TopCat.disk.{u} n, Y), F.comp (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom = f := by
116   let s : TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n ≃ₜ sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 :=
117     Homeomorph.ulift
118   let d : TopCat.disk.{u} n ≃ₜ closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 :=
119     Homeomorph.ulift
120   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := contractible_extends_ball (f.comp ⟨s.symm, s.symm.continuous⟩)
121   refine ⟨F.comp ⟨d, d.continuous⟩, ContinuousMap.ext fun x => ?_⟩
122   exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x.down
123 
124 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  3 import BC4lean.FixedPointCriterion
  4 
  5 /-!
  6 # Extension over equivariant disk cells
  7 
  8 Contractibility of the H-fixed points gives extension over a Γ/H-cell.
  9 This is the single-cell extension step, not yet the full cellular mapping theorem.
 10 -/
 11 
 12 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 13 
 14 universe u v
 15 
 16 variable {Γ : Type u} {X : Type v} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
 17 variable [TopologicalSpace X] [MulAction Γ X] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ X]
 18 
 19 /-- A map on the boundary of an orbit cell extends when the fixed-point target is contractible. -/
 20 theorem orbitCell_extends_of_contractible (H : Subgroup Γ)
 21     [ContractibleSpace (FixedPointSpace H X)] (n : ℕ)
 22     (f : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n)) X) :
 23     ∃ F : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.disk.{u} n)) X,
 24       F.comp (OrbitCell.boundaryInclusion H n) = f := by
 25   apply (orbitCell_extension_iff H (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom f).mpr
 26   exact contractible_extends_disk n (cellEvaluation H f)
 27 
 28 /-- The fixed-point criterion supplies extension for each finite-isotropy orbit cell. -/
 29 theorem FixedPointCriterion.orbitCell_extends (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X)
 30     (H : Subgroup Γ) [Finite H] (n : ℕ)
 31     (f : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n)) X) :
 32     ∃ F : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.disk.{u} n)) X,
 33       F.comp (OrbitCell.boundaryInclusion H n) = f := by
 34   let := h.1 H inferInstance
 35   exact orbitCell_extends_of_contractible H n f
 36

源码 SHA-256：6b3b2f58b2bdebef65374362441418dfcc95116f4c5159d53b124bc49dd87a0e

  1 import BC4lean.OrbitCellExtension
  2 import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.SmallObject.TransfiniteCompositionLifting
  3 
  4 /-!
  5 # Extension over equivariant CW complexes
  6 
  7 The single-cell extension property is preserved by coproducts, pushouts and
  8 sequential colimits. Thus maps into a target with contractible finite-subgroup
  9 fixed points extend over a relative equivariant CW complex.
 10 -/
 11 
 12 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 13 
 14 open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits
 15 
 16 universe u
 17 
 18 variable {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
 19 variable {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [MulAction Γ X] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ X]
 20 
 21 /-- Each generating orbit cell lifts against the map from the target to a point. -/
 22 theorem basicCell_hasLiftingProperty (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X)
 23     (n : ℕ) (H : FiniteIsotropy Γ) :
 24     HasLiftingProperty (equivariantBasicCell n H) (terminal.from (topologicalAction Γ X)) := by
 25   constructor
 26   intro a b sq
 27   let : Finite H.val := H.property
 28   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := h.orbitCell_extends H.val n (EquivariantMap.ofActionHom a)
 29   refine ⟨⟨{ l := F.toActionHom, fac_left := ?_, fac_right := ?_ }⟩⟩
 30   · have hf := congrArg EquivariantMap.toActionHom hF
 31     exact hf.trans (EquivariantMap.actionHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply a)
 32   · exact terminalIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
 33 
 34 /-- The cellwise lifting property persists across the full relative CW structure. -/
 35 theorem RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.hasLiftingProperty
 36     {A B : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} {i : A ⟶ B}
 37     (c : RelativeEquivariantCWComplex i) (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) :
 38     HasLiftingProperty i (terminal.from (topologicalAction Γ X)) := by
 39   let W := MorphismProperty.ofHoms (fun p : ℕ × FiniteIsotropy Γ =>
 40     equivariantBasicCell p.1 p.2)
 41   have hc : ∀ s : c.Cells, W (equivariantBasicCell s.j s.i) :=
 42     fun s => MorphismProperty.ofHoms.mk (s.j, s.i)
 43   have hr : W.rlp (terminal.from (topologicalAction Γ X)) := by
 44     intro A B f hf
 45     cases hf with
 46     | mk p => exact basicCell_hasLiftingProperty h p.1 p.2
 47   exact W.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape_pushouts_coproducts_le_llp_rlp ℕ i
 48     ⟨c.transfiniteCompositionOfShape' hc⟩ _ hr
 49 
 50 /-- Maps into a target satisfying the fixed-point criterion extend over relative CW complexes. -/
 51 theorem RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.extend
 52     {A B : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} {i : A ⟶ B}
 53     (c : RelativeEquivariantCWComplex i) (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X)
 54     (f : A ⟶ topologicalAction Γ X) :
 55     ∃ F : B ⟶ topologicalAction Γ X, i ≫ F = f := by
 56   let := c.hasLiftingProperty h
 57   let sq : CommSq f i (terminal.from (topologicalAction Γ X)) (terminal.from B) :=
 58     ⟨terminalIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _⟩
 59   exact ⟨sq.lift, sq.fac_left⟩
 60 
 61 /-- Every equivariant CW complex admits a map into a target satisfying the fixed-point criterion. -/
 62 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.nonempty_map
 63     {A : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} (c : EquivariantCWComplex A) (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) :
 64     Nonempty (A ⟶ topologicalAction Γ X) := by
 65   obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := c.extend h (initial.to _)
 66   exact ⟨F⟩
 67 
 68 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  2 
  3 /-! # A quotient presentation of the boundary of a disk cylinder
  4 
  5 The product norm on ℝ × E is the max norm. Its unit sphere consists of the
  6 two disk faces and the cylinder on the unit sphere of E.
  7 -/
  8 
  9 noncomputable section
 10 open Metric
 11 open scoped unitInterval
 12 
 13 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 14 
 15 variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
 16 
 17 /-- Affine coordinate identifying the unit interval with [-1,1]. -/
 18 def signedTime (t : I) : ℝ := 2 * (t : ℝ) - 1
 19 
 20 @[simp] theorem signedTime_zero : signedTime 0 = -1 := by norm_num [signedTime]
 21 @[simp] theorem signedTime_one : signedTime 1 = 1 := by norm_num [signedTime]
 22 
 23 theorem abs_signedTime_le (t : I) : |signedTime t| ≤ 1 := by
 24   rw [abs_le]
 25   have h := t.2
 26   dsimp [signedTime]
 27   constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
 28 
 29 theorem signedTime_injective : Function.Injective signedTime := by
 30   intro t u h
 31   apply Subtype.ext
 32   dsimp [signedTime] at h
 33   linarith
 34 
 35 /-- The cylinder parametrized as the max-norm ball. -/
 36 def cylinderBall : C(I × closedBall (0 : E) 1, closedBall (0 : ℝ × E) 1) := by
 37   refine ⟨fun p => ⟨(signedTime p.1, p.2.1), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 38   · rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_mk, Real.norm_eq_abs, max_le_iff]
 39     exact ⟨abs_signedTime_le _, by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using p.2.2⟩
 40   · exact (((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).const_mul 2 |>.sub continuous_const).prodMk
 41       (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).subtype_mk _
 42 
 43 /-- The lower disk face of the cylinder boundary. -/
 44 def cylinderFaceZero : C(closedBall (0 : E) 1, sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1) := by
 45   refine ⟨fun x => ⟨(-1, x.1), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 46   · have hx : ‖x.1‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using x.2
 47     simp only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_mk, norm_neg, norm_one, max_eq_left hx]
 48   · exact (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
 49 
 50 /-- The upper disk face of the cylinder boundary. -/
 51 def cylinderFaceOne : C(closedBall (0 : E) 1, sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1) := by
 52   refine ⟨fun x => ⟨(1, x.1), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 53   · have hx : ‖x.1‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using x.2
 54     simp only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_mk, norm_one, max_eq_left hx]
 55   · exact (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
 56 
 57 /-- The cylindrical side of the boundary. -/
 58 def cylinderSide : C(I × sphere (0 : E) 1, sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1) := by
 59   refine ⟨fun p => ⟨(signedTime p.1, p.2.1), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 60   · simp only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_mk, Real.norm_eq_abs,
 61       norm_eq_of_mem_sphere, max_eq_right (abs_signedTime_le p.1)]
 62   · exact (((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).const_mul 2 |>.sub continuous_const).prodMk
 63       (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).subtype_mk _
 64 
 65 /-- Disjoint union of the two faces and the cylindrical side. -/
 66 abbrev CylinderBoundaryPieces (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] :=
 67   closedBall (0 : E) 1 ⊕ (closedBall (0 : E) 1 ⊕ (I × sphere (0 : E) 1))
 68 
 69 /-- Glue the three boundary pieces into the max-norm unit sphere. -/
 70 def cylinderBoundaryQuotient : C(CylinderBoundaryPieces E, sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1) :=
 71   ⟨Sum.elim cylinderFaceZero (Sum.elim cylinderFaceOne cylinderSide),
 72     continuous_sum_dom.mpr ⟨cylinderFaceZero.continuous,
 73       continuous_sum_dom.mpr ⟨cylinderFaceOne.continuous, cylinderSide.continuous⟩⟩⟩
 74 
 75 /-- The three pieces cover the sphere, including in dimension zero. -/
 76 theorem cylinderBoundaryQuotient_surjective :
 77     Function.Surjective (cylinderBoundaryQuotient (E := E)) := by
 78   intro x
 79   have hx : max |x.1.1| ‖x.1.2‖ = 1 := by
 80     simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using x.2
 81   have hb : ‖x.1.2‖ ≤ 1 := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_of_eq hx)
 82   let b : closedBall (0 : E) 1 := ⟨x.1.2, by simpa only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hb⟩
 83   by_cases h0 : x.1.1 = -1
 84   · exact ⟨Sum.inl b, Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h0.symm rfl)⟩
 85   by_cases h1 : x.1.1 = 1
 86   · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl b), Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h1.symm rfl)⟩
 87   have hr : |x.1.1| ≤ 1 := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_of_eq hx)
 88   have hn : ‖x.1.2‖ = 1 := by
 89     rcases max_eq_iff.mp hx with h | h
 90     · rcases (abs_eq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).mp h.1 with h | h
 91       · exact False.elim (h1 h)
 92       · exact False.elim (h0 h)
 93     · exact h.1
 94   let t : I := ⟨(x.1.1 + 1) / 2, by constructor <;> linarith [abs_le.mp hr]⟩
 95   let s : sphere (0 : E) 1 := ⟨x.1.2, by simpa only [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hn⟩
 96   refine ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (t,s)), Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ?_ rfl)⟩
 97   change 2 * ((x.1.1 + 1) / 2) - 1 = x.1.1
 98   ring
 99 
100 /-- Compactness of the pieces makes the boundary presentation a quotient map. -/
101 theorem cylinderBoundaryQuotient_isQuotientMap [ProperSpace E] :
102     Topology.IsQuotientMap (cylinderBoundaryQuotient (E := E)) :=
103   .of_surjective_continuous cylinderBoundaryQuotient_surjective cylinderBoundaryQuotient.continuous
104 
105 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  1 import BC4lean.CylinderBoundary
  2 
  3 /-! # Extending prescribed disk endpoint maps and a boundary homotopy -/
  4 
  5 noncomputable section
  6 open Metric
  7 open scoped unitInterval
  8 
  9 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 10 
 11 variable {E Y : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [TopologicalSpace Y]
 12 variable (f₀ f₁ : C(closedBall (0 : E) 1, Y))
 13 variable (H : (f₀.comp sphereInclusion).Homotopy (f₁.comp sphereInclusion))
 14 
 15 /-- Values prescribed on the two disk faces and their common cylindrical side. -/
 16 def cylinderBoundaryData : C(CylinderBoundaryPieces E, Y) :=
 17   ⟨Sum.elim f₀ (Sum.elim f₁ H),
 18     continuous_sum_dom.mpr ⟨f₀.continuous,
 19       continuous_sum_dom.mpr ⟨f₁.continuous, H.continuous⟩⟩⟩
 20 
 21 private theorem faceZero_side_agree (x : closedBall (0 : E) 1) (p : I × sphere (0 : E) 1)
 22     (h : cylinderFaceZero x = cylinderSide p) : f₀ x = H p := by
 23   have ht : (0 : I) = p.1 := signedTime_injective (by
 24     rw [signedTime_zero]
 25     exact congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.1) h)
 26   have hx : x = sphereInclusion p.2 :=
 27     Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.2) h)
 28   change f₀ x = H (p.1, p.2)
 29   rw [← ht, H.apply_zero]
 30   exact congrArg f₀ hx
 31 
 32 private theorem faceOne_side_agree (x : closedBall (0 : E) 1) (p : I × sphere (0 : E) 1)
 33     (h : cylinderFaceOne x = cylinderSide p) : f₁ x = H p := by
 34   have ht : (1 : I) = p.1 := signedTime_injective (by
 35     rw [signedTime_one]
 36     exact congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.1) h)
 37   have hx : x = sphereInclusion p.2 :=
 38     Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.2) h)
 39   change f₁ x = H (p.1, p.2)
 40   rw [← ht, H.apply_one]
 41   exact congrArg f₁ hx
 42 
 43 /-- The endpoint identities are exactly the compatibility conditions for boundary gluing. -/
 44 theorem cylinderBoundaryData_factorsThrough :
 45     Function.FactorsThrough (cylinderBoundaryData f₀ f₁ H) cylinderBoundaryQuotient := by
 46   intro p q h
 47   rcases p with x | x
 48   · rcases q with y | y
 49     · exact congrArg f₀ (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.2) h))
 50     · rcases y with y | y
 51       · have ht := congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.1) h
 52         change (-1 : ℝ) = 1 at ht
 53         norm_num at ht
 54       · exact faceZero_side_agree f₀ f₁ H x y h
 55   · rcases x with x | x
 56     · rcases q with y | y
 57       · have ht := congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.1) h
 58         change (1 : ℝ) = -1 at ht
 59         norm_num at ht
 60       · rcases y with y | y
 61         · exact congrArg f₁ (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.2) h))
 62         · exact faceOne_side_agree f₀ f₁ H x y h
 63     · rcases q with y | y
 64       · exact (faceZero_side_agree f₀ f₁ H y x h.symm).symm
 65       · rcases y with y | y
 66         · exact (faceOne_side_agree f₀ f₁ H y x h.symm).symm
 67         · apply congrArg H
 68           exact Prod.ext
 69             (signedTime_injective (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.1) h))
 70             (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1 => z.1.2) h))
 71 
 72 /-- Glue endpoint maps and a boundary homotopy into a map on the cylinder boundary. -/
 73 def gluedCylinderBoundary [ProperSpace E] : C(sphere (0 : ℝ × E) 1, Y) :=
 74   cylinderBoundaryQuotient_isQuotientMap.lift (cylinderBoundaryData f₀ f₁ H)
 75     (cylinderBoundaryData_factorsThrough f₀ f₁ H)
 76 
 77 @[simp] theorem gluedCylinderBoundary_on_piece [ProperSpace E] (p : CylinderBoundaryPieces E) :
 78     gluedCylinderBoundary f₀ f₁ H (cylinderBoundaryQuotient p) =
 79       cylinderBoundaryData f₀ f₁ H p :=
 80   ContinuousMap.congr_fun (cylinderBoundaryQuotient_isQuotientMap.lift_comp
 81     (cylinderBoundaryData f₀ f₁ H) (cylinderBoundaryData_factorsThrough f₀ f₁ H)) p
 82 
 83 variable [NormedSpace ℝ E]
 84 
 85 /-- Into a contractible target, a sphere homotopy extends over the ball with both endpoints fixed. -/
 86 theorem contractible_extends_ball_homotopy [ProperSpace E] [ContractibleSpace Y] :
 87     ∃ F : f₀.Homotopy f₁, ∀ t s, F (t, sphereInclusion s) = H (t, s) := by
 88   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := contractible_extends_ball (gluedCylinderBoundary f₀ f₁ H)
 89   have he (p : CylinderBoundaryPieces E) :
 90       F (sphereInclusion (cylinderBoundaryQuotient p)) = cylinderBoundaryData f₀ f₁ H p :=
 91     (ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF (cylinderBoundaryQuotient p)).trans
 92       (gluedCylinderBoundary_on_piece f₀ f₁ H p)
 93   refine ⟨{ toContinuousMap := F.comp cylinderBall,
 94             map_zero_left := ?_, map_one_left := ?_ }, ?_⟩
 95   · intro x
 96     change F (cylinderBall (0,x)) = f₀ x
 97     calc
 98       F (cylinderBall (0,x)) = F (sphereInclusion (cylinderBoundaryQuotient (Sum.inl x))) := by
 99         apply congrArg F
100         apply Subtype.ext
101         exact Prod.ext signedTime_zero rfl
102       _ = _ := he (Sum.inl x)
103   · intro x
104     change F (cylinderBall (1,x)) = f₁ x
105     calc
106       F (cylinderBall (1,x)) = F (sphereInclusion (cylinderBoundaryQuotient (Sum.inr (Sum.inl x)))) := by
107         apply congrArg F
108         apply Subtype.ext
109         exact Prod.ext signedTime_one rfl
110       _ = _ := he (Sum.inr (Sum.inl x))
111   · intro t s
112     exact he (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (t,s)))
113 
114 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  1 import BC4lean.DiskHomotopyExtension
  2 
  3 /-! # Path lifting across the standard disk boundary inclusion -/
  4 
  5 noncomputable section
  6 open scoped unitInterval
  7 
  8 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
  9 
 10 universe u
 11 
 12 /-- A prescribed boundary homotopy extends over a standard disk, with endpoints unchanged. -/
 13 theorem contractible_extends_disk_homotopy {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
 14     [ContractibleSpace Y] (n : ℕ) (f₀ f₁ : C(TopCat.disk.{u} n, Y))
 15     (H : (f₀.comp (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom).Homotopy
 16       (f₁.comp (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom)) :
 17     ∃ F : f₀.Homotopy f₁, ∀ t s, F (t, (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n) s) = H (t,s) := by
 18   let b : C(Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1, TopCat.disk.{u} n) :=
 19     ⟨ULift.up, continuous_uliftUp⟩
 20   let s : C(Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1, TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n) :=
 21     ⟨ULift.up, continuous_uliftUp⟩
 22   let h : ((f₀.comp b).comp sphereInclusion).Homotopy ((f₁.comp b).comp sphereInclusion) :=
 23     H.compContinuousMap s
 24   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := contractible_extends_ball_homotopy (f₀.comp b) (f₁.comp b) h
 25   let d : C(TopCat.disk.{u} n, Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
 26     ⟨ULift.down, continuous_uliftDown⟩
 27   exact ⟨F.compContinuousMap d, fun t x => hF t x.down⟩
 28 
 29 /-- Endpoint-preserving extension of a continuous family of boundary paths. -/
 30 theorem contractible_disk_path_lifting {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
 31     [ContractibleSpace Y] (n : ℕ)
 32     (a : C(TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n, C(I,Y))) (f₀ f₁ : C(TopCat.disk.{u} n, Y))
 33     (h₀ : ∀ s, a s 0 = f₀ ((TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n) s))
 34     (h₁ : ∀ s, a s 1 = f₁ ((TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n) s)) :
 35     ∃ F : C(TopCat.disk.{u} n, C(I,Y)),
 36       (∀ s, F ((TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n) s) = a s) ∧
 37       (∀ x, F x 0 = f₀ x) ∧ (∀ x, F x 1 = f₁ x) := by
 38   let H : (f₀.comp (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom).Homotopy
 39       (f₁.comp (TopCat.diskBoundaryInclusion n).hom) :=
 40     { toContinuousMap := a.uncurry.comp ContinuousMap.prodSwap,
 41       map_zero_left := h₀, map_one_left := h₁ }
 42   obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := contractible_extends_disk_homotopy n f₀ f₁ H
 43   refine ⟨(G.toContinuousMap.comp ContinuousMap.prodSwap).curry, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
 44   · intro s
 45     exact ContinuousMap.ext (fun t => hG t s)
 46   · exact G.apply_zero
 47   · exact G.apply_one
 48 
 49 end BC4lean.ProperActions

 17 /-- Evaluation of an equivariant path at a fixed time. -/

 19   toFun p := p t
 20   continuous_toFun := continuous_eval_const t
 21   map_smul' _ _ := rfl
 22 
 23 /-- A path fixed by H is a continuous path in the H-fixed-point space. -/
 24 def fixedPathMap (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 25     C(FixedPointSpace H C(I,X), C(I,FixedPointSpace H X)) where
 26   toFun p :=
 27     ⟨fun t => ⟨p.1 t, fun h => congrArg (fun q : C(I,X) => q t) (p.2 h)⟩,
 28       p.1.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
 29   continuous_toFun := ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry _
 30     (((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).eval continuous_snd).subtype_mk _)
 31 
 32 /-- A path in the fixed-point space gives an H-fixed path. -/
 33 def pathFixedMap (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 34     C(C(I,FixedPointSpace H X), FixedPointSpace H C(I,X)) where
 35   toFun p := ⟨⟨fun t => (p t).1, continuous_subtype_val.comp p.continuous⟩,
 36     fun h => ContinuousMap.ext (fun t => (p t).2 h)⟩
 37   continuous_toFun :=
 38     (ContinuousMap.continuous_postcomp ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩).subtype_mk _

 41     pathFixedMap H (fixedPathMap H p) = p := by

 45 @[simp] theorem fixedPathMap_pathFixedMap (H : Subgroup Γ) (p : C(I,FixedPointSpace H X)) :

 50 
 51 /-- Lift a family of boundary paths with prescribed disk endpoints across an orbit cell. -/
 52 theorem orbitCell_path_lifting (H : Subgroup Γ) [ContractibleSpace (FixedPointSpace H X)]
 53     (n : ℕ) (a : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.diskBoundary.{u} n)) C(I,X))
 54     (f₀ f₁ : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.disk.{u} n)) X)
 55     (h₀ : (pathEvaluation 0).comp a = f₀.comp (OrbitCell.boundaryInclusion H n))
 56     (h₁ : (pathEvaluation 1).comp a = f₁.comp (OrbitCell.boundaryInclusion H n)) :
 57     ∃ F : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H (TopCat.disk.{u} n)) C(I,X),
 58       F.comp (OrbitCell.boundaryInclusion H n) = a ∧
 59       (pathEvaluation 0).comp F = f₀ ∧ (pathEvaluation 1).comp F = f₁ := by
 60   let a' := (fixedPathMap H).comp (cellEvaluation H a)
 61   obtain ⟨v, hv, hzero, hone⟩ := contractible_disk_path_lifting n a'

 63     (fun s => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun f => f (QuotientGroup.mk 1,s)) h₀))
 64     (fun s => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun f => f (QuotientGroup.mk 1,s)) h₁))
 65   let F := cellFromFixed H ((pathFixedMap H).comp v)

 67     (orbitCellMapEquiv H).apply_symm_apply _

 76     rw [hv]

 82     have hx := congrArg (fun p : FixedPointSpace H C(I,X) => p.1 0)
 83       (ContinuousMap.congr_fun he x)
 84     exact hx.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (hzero x))
 85   · apply (orbitCellMapEquiv H).injective
 86     apply ContinuousMap.ext
 87     intro x
 88     apply Subtype.ext
 89     have hx := congrArg (fun p : FixedPointSpace H C(I,X) => p.1 1)

 16 /-- The equivariant map recording both endpoints of a path. -/
 17 def pathEndpointPair : EquivariantMap Γ C(I,X) (X × X) where
 18   toFun p := (p 0, p 1)
 19   continuous_toFun := (continuous_eval_const 0).prodMk (continuous_eval_const 1)
 20   map_smul' _ _ := rfl

 22 /-- Contractible fixed-point targets lift orbit cells against path endpoint evaluation. -/
 23 theorem basicCell_path_hasLiftingProperty (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X)
 24     (n : ℕ) (H : FiniteIsotropy Γ) :
 25     HasLiftingProperty (equivariantBasicCell n H) (pathEndpointPair (Γ := Γ) (X := X)).toActionHom := by
 26   constructor
 27   intro a b sq
 28   let : ContractibleSpace (FixedPointSpace H.val X) := h.1 H.val H.property
 29   let a' := EquivariantMap.ofActionHom a
 30   let b' := EquivariantMap.ofActionHom b

 32     { toFun := fun x => (b' x).1,

 34       map_smul' := fun g x => congrArg Prod.fst (b'.map_smul g x) }
 35   let f₁ : EquivariantMap Γ (OrbitCell H.val (TopCat.disk.{u} n)) X :=
 36     { toFun := fun x => (b' x).2,
 37       continuous_toFun := continuous_snd.comp b'.continuous,

 41     (EquivariantMap.ext fun x => congrArg (fun k => (k.hom x).2) sq.w)
 42   refine ⟨⟨{ l := F.toActionHom, fac_left := ?_, fac_right := ?_ }⟩⟩
 43   · exact (congrArg EquivariantMap.toActionHom hi).trans
 44       (EquivariantMap.actionHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply a)
 45   · apply Action.Hom.ext
 46     apply TopCat.hom_ext
 47     apply ContinuousMap.ext
 48     intro x
 49     exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun f => f x) h₀) (congrArg (fun f => f x) h₁)
 50 
 51 /-- Path endpoint lifting extends from cells to every relative equivariant CW structure. -/
 52 theorem RelativeEquivariantCWComplex.path_hasLiftingProperty
 53     {A B : Action TopCat.{u} Γ} {i : A ⟶ B}
 54     (c : RelativeEquivariantCWComplex i) (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) :
 55     HasLiftingProperty i (pathEndpointPair (Γ := Γ) (X := X)).toActionHom := by
 56   let W := MorphismProperty.ofHoms (fun p : ℕ × FiniteIsotropy Γ => equivariantBasicCell p.1 p.2)
 57   have hc : ∀ s : c.Cells, W (equivariantBasicCell s.j s.i) :=
 58     fun s => MorphismProperty.ofHoms.mk (s.j, s.i)
 59   have hr : W.rlp (pathEndpointPair (Γ := Γ) (X := X)).toActionHom := by
 60     intro A B f hf
 61     cases hf with
 62     | mk p => exact basicCell_path_hasLiftingProperty h p.1 p.2
 63   exact W.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape_pushouts_coproducts_le_llp_rlp ℕ i
 64     ⟨c.transfiniteCompositionOfShape' hc⟩ _ hr
 65 
 66 variable {A : Type u} [TopologicalSpace A] [MulAction Γ A] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ A]
 67 
 68 /-- Any two maps from an equivariant CW complex into a fixed-point-criterion target are homotopic. -/
 69 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.homotopic (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A))
 70     (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) (f g : EquivariantMap Γ A X) : EquivariantlyHomotopic f g := by
 71   let b : EquivariantMap Γ A (X × X) :=
 72     { toFun := fun x => (f x, g x), continuous_toFun := f.continuous.prodMk g.continuous,
 73       map_smul' := fun a x => Prod.ext (f.map_smul a x) (g.map_smul a x) }
 74   let := c.path_hasLiftingProperty h
 75   let sq : CommSq (initial.to (topologicalAction Γ C(I,X)))
 76       (initial.to (topologicalAction Γ A)) (pathEndpointPair (Γ := Γ) (X := X)).toActionHom
 77       b.toActionHom := ⟨initialIsInitial.hom_ext _ _⟩
 78   let F := EquivariantMap.ofActionHom sq.lift
 79   have he (x : A) : (F x 0, F x 1) = (f x, g x) :=
 80     congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) sq.fac_right
 81   refine ⟨{ toHomotopy :=
 82     { toFun := fun p => F p.2 p.1,
 83       continuous_toFun := (F.continuous.comp continuous_snd).eval continuous_fst,
 84       map_zero_left := fun x => congrArg Prod.fst (he x),
 85       map_one_left := fun x => congrArg Prod.snd (he x) }, prop' := ?_ }⟩
 86   intro t a x
 87   exact congrArg (fun p : C(I,X) => p t) (F.map_smul a x)
 88 
 89 /-- The fixed-point criterion implies the homotopy-terminal mapping property for CW sources. -/
 90 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.homotopyTerminal (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A))
 91     (h : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) : HomotopyTerminalFor Γ A X := by
 92   obtain ⟨f⟩ := c.nonempty_map h
 93   exact ⟨⟨EquivariantMap.ofActionHom f⟩, c.homotopic h⟩
 94 
 95 /-- Two equivariant CW spaces satisfying the fixed-point criterion are equivariantly homotopy equivalent. -/
 96 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.fixedPointCriterion_unique
 97     (cA : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A))
 98     (cX : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ X))
 99     (hA : FixedPointCriterion Γ A) (hX : FixedPointCriterion Γ X) :
100     Nonempty (EquivariantHomotopyEquiv Γ A X) :=
101   homotopyTerminal_unique (cA.homotopyTerminal hX) (cX.homotopyTerminal hA)
102     (cA.homotopyTerminal hA) (cX.homotopyTerminal hX)
103 
104 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  1 import BC4lean.FixedPointCriterion
  2 import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Contractible
  3 import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Real
  4 import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences
  5 
  6 /-! # The probability simplex with pointwise convergence
  7 
  8 This constructs a concrete Γ-space. No equivariant CW structure or local
  9 compactness is assumed in this definition.
 10 -/
 11 
 12 noncomputable section
 13 open scoped BigOperators
 14 
 15 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 16 
 17 /-- Real nonnegative summable functions with total mass one. -/
 18 def probabilitySet (Γ : Type*) : Set (Γ → ℝ) :=
 19   {f | (∀ g, 0 ≤ f g) ∧ Summable f ∧ ∑' g, f g = 1}
 20 
 21 /-- The probability simplex, with the subspace topology from pointwise convergence. -/
 22 abbrev ProbabilitySimplex (Γ : Type*) := probabilitySet Γ
 23 
 24 /-- The probability simplex is convex in the real function space. -/
 25 theorem probabilitySet_convex (Γ : Type*) : Convex ℝ (probabilitySet Γ) := by
 26   intro f hf g hg a b ha hb hab
 27   refine ⟨fun x => add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (hf.1 x)) (mul_nonneg hb (hg.1 x)),
 28     (hf.2.1.mul_left a).add (hg.2.1.mul_left b), ?_⟩
 29   change (∑' x, (a * f x + b * g x)) = 1
 30   rw [Summable.tsum_add (hf.2.1.mul_left a) (hg.2.1.mul_left b),
 31     tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left, hf.2.2, hg.2.2, mul_one, mul_one]
 32   exact hab
 33 
 34 namespace ProbabilitySimplex
 35 variable {Γ : Type*}
 36 
 37 /-- The unit mass at one index. -/
 38 def delta (g : Γ) : ProbabilitySimplex Γ := by
 39   classical
 40   refine ⟨Pi.single g 1, ?_, (by
 41     convert (hasSum_ite_eq g (1 : ℝ)).summable using 1
 42     funext x
 43     simp [Pi.single_apply]), ?_⟩
 44   · intro x
 45     by_cases h : x = g <;> simp [h]
 46   · simp
 47 
 48 /-- A finite set carries at most the total mass. -/
 49 theorem sum_le_one (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) (s : Finset Γ) :
 50     ∑ g ∈ s, p.1 g ≤ 1 := by
 51   rw [← p.2.2.2]
 52   exact p.2.2.1.sum_le_tsum s (fun g _ => p.2.1 g)
 53 
 54 /-- Every probability function has more than half its mass on some finite set. -/
 55 theorem exists_half_mass (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :
 56     ∃ s : Finset Γ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ g ∈ s, p.1 g := by
 57   by_contra! h
 58   have hh := p.2.2.1.tsum_le_of_sum_le h
 59   rw [p.2.2.2] at hh
 60   norm_num at hh
 61 
 62 variable [Group Γ]
 63 
 64 /-- Left translation of a probability function. -/
 65 def translate (g : Γ) (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) : ProbabilitySimplex Γ :=
 66   ⟨fun x => p.1 (g⁻¹ * x), fun x => p.2.1 (g⁻¹ * x),
 67     (Equiv.mulLeft g⁻¹).summable_iff.mpr p.2.2.1,
 68     ((Equiv.mulLeft g⁻¹).tsum_eq p.1).trans p.2.2.2⟩
 69 
 70 instance instMulAction : MulAction Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) where
 71   smul := translate
 72   one_smul p := by
 73     apply Subtype.ext
 74     funext x
 75     change p.1 (1⁻¹ * x) = p.1 x
 76     simp
 77   mul_smul g h p := by
 78     apply Subtype.ext
 79     funext x
 80     change p.1 ((g * h)⁻¹ * x) = p.1 (h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * x))
 81     simp [mul_assoc]
 82 
 83 @[simp] theorem smul_apply (g : Γ) (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) (x : Γ) :
 84     (g • p).1 x = p.1 (g⁻¹ * x) := rfl
 85 
 86 instance instContinuousConstSMul : ContinuousConstSMul Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) where
 87   continuous_const_smul g := by
 88     change Continuous (translate g)
 89     apply Continuous.subtype_mk
 90     exact continuous_pi fun x => (continuous_apply (g⁻¹ * x)).comp continuous_subtype_val
 91 
 92 /-- The whole simplex is contractible; the fixed-subspace statement is proved separately. -/
 93 theorem contractible : ContractibleSpace (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 94   (probabilitySet_convex Γ).contractibleSpace ⟨(delta (1 : Γ)).1, (delta (1 : Γ)).2⟩
 95 
 96 end ProbabilitySimplex
 97 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  1 import BC4lean.ProbabilitySimplex
  2 
  3 /-! # Fixed points of the probability simplex -/
  4 
  5 noncomputable section
  6 open scoped BigOperators
  7 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
  8 
  9 variable {Γ : Type*} [Group Γ]
 10 
 11 /-- The invariant probability functions for a subgroup, as a convex subset of function space. -/
 12 def invariantProbabilitySet (H : Subgroup Γ) : Set (Γ → ℝ) :=
 13   {f | f ∈ probabilitySet Γ ∧ ∀ h : H, ∀ x, f ((h : Γ)⁻¹ * x) = f x}
 14 
 15 /-- Invariance and normalization are preserved under convex combinations. -/
 16 theorem invariantProbabilitySet_convex (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 17     Convex ℝ (invariantProbabilitySet H) := by
 18   intro f hf g hg a b ha hb hab
 19   refine ⟨probabilitySet_convex Γ hf.1 hg.1 ha hb hab, ?_⟩
 20   intro h x
 21   change a * f ((h : Γ)⁻¹ * x) + b * g ((h : Γ)⁻¹ * x) = a * f x + b * g x
 22   rw [hf.2 h x, hg.2 h x]
 23 
 24 /-- Fixed points are homeomorphic to the invariant convex subset. -/
 25 def probabilityFixedPointsHomeomorph (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 26     FixedPointSpace H (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) ≃ₜ invariantProbabilitySet H where
 27   toFun p := ⟨p.1.1, p.1.2, fun h x => congrArg (fun q : ProbabilitySimplex Γ => q.1 x) (p.2 h)⟩
 28   invFun f := ⟨⟨f.1, f.2.1⟩, fun h => Subtype.ext (funext (f.2.2 h))⟩
 29   left_inv _ := rfl
 30   right_inv _ := rfl
 31   continuous_toFun := (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
 32   continuous_invFun := (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _).subtype_mk _
 33 
 34 /-- A finite subgroup has an invariant probability function: its uniform distribution. -/
 35 theorem invariantProbabilitySet_nonempty (H : Subgroup Γ) [Finite H] :
 36     (invariantProbabilitySet H).Nonempty := by
 37   classical
 38   let := Fintype.ofFinite H
 39   let c : ℝ := (Fintype.card H : ℝ)⁻¹
 40   let f : Γ → ℝ := (H : Set Γ).indicator (fun _ => c)
 41   have hc : 0 ≤ c := by dsimp [c]; positivity
 42   have hcard : (Fintype.card H : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
 43   refine ⟨f, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
 44   · intro x
 45     exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => hc) x
 46   · exact summable_of_hasFiniteSupport ((Set.toFinite (H : Set Γ)).subset Set.support_indicator_subset)
 47   · change (∑' x, (H : Set Γ).indicator (fun _ => c) x) = 1
 48     rw [← tsum_subtype]
 49     simp [tsum_fintype, c, hcard]
 50   · intro h x
 51     simp only [f, Set.indicator_apply, SetLike.mem_coe]
 52     rw [H.mul_mem_cancel_left (H.inv_mem h.2)]
 53 
 54 namespace ProbabilitySimplex
 55 
 56 /-- Finite-subgroup fixed points of the simplex are contractible. -/
 57 theorem fixedPoints_contractible (H : Subgroup Γ) [Finite H] :
 58     ContractibleSpace (FixedPointSpace H (ProbabilitySimplex Γ)) := by
 59   let := (invariantProbabilitySet_convex H).contractibleSpace (invariantProbabilitySet_nonempty H)
 60   exact (probabilityFixedPointsHomeomorph H).contractibleSpace
 61 
 62 /-- Infinite subgroups have no invariant probability functions. -/
 63 theorem fixedPoints_empty (H : Subgroup Γ) [Infinite H] :
 64     IsEmpty (FixedPointSpace H (ProbabilitySimplex Γ)) := by
 65   classical
 66   refine ⟨fun p => ?_⟩
 67   have hex : ∃ x, p.1.1 x ≠ 0 := by
 68     by_contra! hz
 69     have ht := p.1.2.2.2
 70     simp only [hz, tsum_zero] at ht
 71     norm_num at ht
 72   obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
 73   have hpos : 0 < p.1.1 x := lt_of_le_of_ne (p.1.2.1 x) (Ne.symm hx)
 74   have hs : Summable (fun h : H => p.1.1 ((h : Γ) * x)) :=
 75     p.1.2.2.1.comp_injective (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (mul_right_cancel h))
 76   have he (h : H) : p.1.1 ((h : Γ) * x) = p.1.1 x := by
 77     have hfix := congrArg (fun q : ProbabilitySimplex Γ => q.1 x) (p.2 h⁻¹)
 78     change p.1.1 (((h⁻¹ : H) : Γ)⁻¹ * x) = p.1.1 x at hfix
 79     simpa only [Subgroup.coe_inv, inv_inv] using hfix
 80   simp only [he] at hs
 81   let := Finite.of_summable_const hpos hs
 82   exact not_finite H
 83 
 84 /-- The concrete simplex satisfies the full finite/infinite subgroup criterion. -/
 85 theorem fixedPointCriterion : FixedPointCriterion Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 86   ⟨fun H _ => fixedPoints_contractible H, fun H _ => fixedPoints_empty H⟩
 87 
 88 end ProbabilitySimplex
 89 end BC4lean.ProperActions

  1 import BC4lean.ProbabilitySimplex
  2 import BC4lean.ProperActions
  3 
  4 /-! # Properness of the probability-simplex action
  5 
  6 Compact sets of probability functions are uniformly concentrated on a finite
  7 set of coordinates. This bounds all compact transporters by a finite set.
  8 -/
  9 
 10 noncomputable section
 11 open scoped BigOperators Pointwise Classical
 12 
 13 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions.ProbabilitySimplex
 14 
 15 variable {Γ : Type*}
 16 
 17 /-- On a compact set of probability functions, a single finite set carries more than half the mass. -/
 18 theorem compact_half_mass {K : Set (ProbabilitySimplex Γ)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
 19     ∃ s : Finset Γ, ∀ p ∈ K, (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ g ∈ s, p.1 g := by
 20   classical
 21   let U (s : Finset Γ) : Set (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) := {p | (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ g ∈ s, p.1 g}
 22   have ho (s : Finset Γ) : IsOpen (U s) :=
 23     isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_finsetSum s fun g _ =>
 24       (continuous_apply g).comp continuous_subtype_val)
 25   have hc : K ⊆ ⋃ s, U s := by
 26     intro p _
 27     obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_half_mass p
 28     exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs⟩
 29   obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover U ho hc
 30   refine ⟨S.biUnion id, fun p hp => ?_⟩
 31   obtain ⟨s, hs, hps⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS hp)
 32   apply lt_of_lt_of_le hps
 33   exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
 34     (fun g hg => Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hg⟩) (fun g _ _ => p.2.1 g)
 35 
 36 /-- Two finite sets each carrying more than half the mass must intersect. -/
 37 theorem half_mass_inter (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) (s t : Finset Γ)
 38     (hs : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ g ∈ s, p.1 g) (ht : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ g ∈ t, p.1 g) :
 39     (s ∩ t).Nonempty := by
 40   classical
 41   by_contra h
 42   have hd : Disjoint s t := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr
 43     (Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h)
 44   have hle := sum_le_one p (s ∪ t)
 45   rw [Finset.sum_union hd] at hle
 46   linarith
 47 
 48 variable [Group Γ]
 49 
 50 /-- Translation preserves the mass assigned to a finite set. -/
 51 theorem sum_translate_image (g : Γ) (p : ProbabilitySimplex Γ) (s : Finset Γ) :
 52     ∑ x ∈ s.image (fun y => g * y), (g • p).1 x = ∑ y ∈ s, p.1 y := by
 53   classical
 54   rw [Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => mul_left_cancel h)]
 55   simp
 56 
 57 /-- Compact subsets have finite transporters under left translation. -/
 58 theorem finite_compact_transporter {K L : Set (ProbabilitySimplex Γ)}
 59     (hK : IsCompact K) (hL : IsCompact L) :
 60     {g : Γ | (g • K ∩ L).Nonempty}.Finite := by
 61   classical
 62   obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := compact_half_mass hK
 63   obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := compact_half_mass hL
 64   apply ((t.product s).image (fun p => p.1 * p.2⁻¹)).finite_toSet.subset
 65   intro g hg
 66   obtain ⟨q, hq, hqL⟩ := hg
 67   obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hq
 68   have himage : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ∑ x ∈ s.image (fun y => g * y), (g • p).1 x := by
 69     rw [sum_translate_image]
 70     exact hs p hp
 71   obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := half_mass_inter (g • p) (s.image (fun y => g * y)) t himage (ht _ hqL)
 72   obtain ⟨hx, hxt⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
 73   obtain ⟨y, hys, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
 74   exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(g * y,y), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hxt,hys⟩, by simp⟩
 75 
 76 /-- The simplex action is properly discontinuous. -/
 77 theorem properlyDiscontinuous : ProperlyDiscontinuousSMul Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 78   properlyDiscontinuousSMul_iff.mpr (fun hK hL => finite_compact_transporter hK hL)
 79 
 80 /-- For countable discrete groups the probability simplex is a proper Γ-space. -/
 81 theorem proper [Countable Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ] :
 82     ProperSMul Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 83   properlyDiscontinuousSMul_iff_properSMul.mp properlyDiscontinuous
 84 
 85 end BC4lean.ProperActions.ProbabilitySimplex

  1 import BC4lean.EquivariantMaps
  2 import BC4lean.ProperActions
  3 
  4 /-! # Properness transferred along an equivariant map -/
  5 
  6 open Filter Topology
  7 
  8 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
  9 
 10 variable {Γ A X : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ]
 11 variable [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace X] [MulAction Γ A] [MulAction Γ X]
 12 
 13 /-- A Hausdorff continuous Γ-space mapping equivariantly to a proper Γ-space is proper. -/
 14 theorem EquivariantMap.properSMul [T2Space A] [ContinuousSMul Γ A] [ProperSMul Γ X]
 15     (f : EquivariantMap Γ A X) : ProperSMul Γ A := by
 16   apply properSMul_iff_continuousSMul_ultrafilter_tendsto_t2.mpr
 17   refine ⟨inferInstance, fun U a b hab => ?_⟩
 18   let m : Γ × A → Γ × X := fun p => (p.1, f p.2)
 19   let V := U.map m
 20   have hv : Tendsto (fun p : Γ × X => (p.1 • p.2,p.2)) V (𝓝 (f a,f b)) := by
 21     rw [show (V : Filter (Γ × X)) = Filter.map m U from Ultrafilter.coe_map m U,
 22       tendsto_map'_iff]
 23     have ht := ((f.continuous.prodMap f.continuous).tendsto (a,b)).comp hab
 24     simpa only [Function.comp_def, Prod.map_apply, m, f.map_smul] using ht
 25   obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ :=
 26     (properSMul_iff_continuousSMul_ultrafilter_tendsto.mp (inferInstance : ProperSMul Γ X)).2
 27       V (f a) (f b) hv
 28   refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
 29   simpa only [V, Ultrafilter.coe_map, tendsto_map'_iff, Function.comp_def, m] using hg
 30

  6 /-! # A concrete proper target for the cellular mapping theorem

 13 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions
 14 
 15 universe u

 17 variable {A : Type u} [TopologicalSpace A] [MulAction Γ A] [ContinuousConstSMul Γ A]
 18 
 19 /-- Every finite-isotropy equivariant CW complex maps to the explicit probability simplex,
 20 uniquely up to equivariant homotopy. -/
 21 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.probability_homotopyTerminal
 22     (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A)) :
 23     HomotopyTerminalFor Γ A (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 24   c.homotopyTerminal ProbabilitySimplex.fixedPointCriterion
 25 
 26 omit [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
 27 /-- For countable Γ, the explicit target has a countable base. -/
 28 theorem ProbabilitySimplex.secondCountable [Countable Γ] :
 29     SecondCountableTopology (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) := inferInstance
 30 
 31 /-- For a countable group, the concrete target is proper and has the full cellular mapping property. -/
 32 theorem probability_proper_universal_target [Countable Γ]
 33     (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A)) :
 34     ProperSMul Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) ∧ HomotopyTerminalFor Γ A (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) :=
 35   ⟨ProbabilitySimplex.proper, c.probability_homotopyTerminal⟩
 36 
 37 /-- A Hausdorff finite-isotropy equivariant CW space has a proper action for countable Γ.
 38 The following unconditional result supplies Hausdorffness from the categorical CW data. -/
 39 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.proper_of_t2 [Countable Γ] [T2Space A]
 40     (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A)) : ProperSMul Γ A := by
 41   let : ProperSMul Γ (ProbabilitySimplex Γ) := ProbabilitySimplex.proper
 42   let : ContinuousSMul Γ A := ⟨continuous_prod_of_discrete_left.mpr continuous_const_smul⟩
 43   obtain ⟨f⟩ := c.probability_homotopyTerminal.1
 44   exact f.properSMul
 45 
 46 
 47 /-- A finite-isotropy equivariant CW space has a proper action for every countable discrete group.
 48 Hausdorffness is derived from the cellular data, rather than imposed as a separate hypothesis. -/
 49 theorem EquivariantCWComplex.proper [Countable Γ]
 50     (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A)) : ProperSMul Γ A := by
 51   let : T2Space A := c.t2Space
 52   exact c.proper_of_t2
 53

 59 namespace BC4lean.ProperActions

 61 variable (Γ : Type u) [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ] [DiscreteTopology Γ]
 62 
 63 namespace UniversalZeroSkeleton
 64 /-- The constructed universal zero-skeleton is a proper Γ-space. -/
 65 theorem proper [Countable Γ] : ProperSMul Γ (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ) := cwComplex.proper
 66 
 67 /-- Infinite subgroups have no fixed vertices. -/
 68 theorem infinite_fixedPoints_empty [Countable Γ] (H : Subgroup Γ) [Infinite H] :
 69     IsEmpty (FixedPointSpace H (UniversalZeroSkeleton Γ)) := by
 70   let := proper Γ
 71   exact fixedPointSpace_isEmpty H
 72 end UniversalZeroSkeleton
 73 
 74 /-- A concrete one-orbit zero-dimensional CW model for a finite group. -/
 75 abbrev FiniteGroupCWModel [Finite Γ] :=
 76   OrbitZeroSkeleton (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => (⟨⊤, inferInstance⟩ : FiniteIsotropy Γ))
 77 
 78 namespace FiniteGroupCWModel
 79 variable [Finite Γ]
 80 instance : Subsingleton (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) := by
 81   let : Subsingleton (Γ ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup Γ)) := QuotientGroup.subsingleton_quotient_top
 82   change Subsingleton (Σ _ : PUnit.{u+1}, OrbitCell (⊤ : Subgroup Γ) (TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
 83   let : Subsingleton (OrbitCell (⊤ : Subgroup Γ) (TopCat.disk.{u} 0)) :=
 84     inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton ((Γ ⧸ (⊤ : Subgroup Γ)) × TopCat.disk.{u} 0))
 85   constructor
 86   rintro ⟨⟨⟩, x⟩ ⟨⟨⟩, y⟩
 87   exact congrArg (Sigma.mk PUnit.unit) (Subsingleton.elim x y)
 88 instance : Nonempty (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) :=
 89   ⟨⟨PUnit.unit, QuotientGroup.mk 1, ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩⟩⟩
 90 
 91 /-- The finite-group model has an actual CW structure with one zero-cell orbit. -/
 92 def cwComplex : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ)) :=
 93   OrbitZeroSkeleton.cwComplex _
 94 
 95 omit [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
 96 /-- Every subgroup fixed-point space of this one-point model is contractible. -/
 97 theorem fixedPoints_contractible (H : Subgroup Γ) :
 98     ContractibleSpace (FixedPointSpace H (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ)) := by
 99   let : Nonempty (FixedPointSpace H (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ)) :=
100     ⟨⟨Classical.choice inferInstance, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
101   infer_instance
102 
103 omit [DiscreteTopology Γ] in
104 /-- For finite groups the explicit CW model satisfies the full fixed-point criterion. -/
105 theorem fixedPointCriterion : FixedPointCriterion Γ (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) := by
106   refine ⟨fun H _ => fixedPoints_contractible Γ H, ?_⟩
107   intro H hH
108   let := hH
109   exact False.elim (not_finite H)
110 
111 /-- The finite-group model is proper, locally compact, and second countable. -/
112 theorem proper_locallyCompact_secondCountable :
113     ProperSMul Γ (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) ∧ LocallyCompactSpace (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) ∧
114       SecondCountableTopology (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) :=
115   ⟨(cwComplex Γ).proper, OrbitZeroSkeleton.locallyCompact _, inferInstance⟩
116 
117 /-- The finite-group CW model has the universal mapping property for every CW source. -/
118 theorem homotopyTerminal {A : Type u} [TopologicalSpace A] [MulAction Γ A]
119     [ContinuousConstSMul Γ A] (c : EquivariantCWComplex (topologicalAction Γ A)) :
120     HomotopyTerminalFor Γ A (FiniteGroupCWModel Γ) :=
121   c.homotopyTerminal (fixedPointCriterion Γ)
122 end FiniteGroupCWModel
123 end BC4lean.ProperActions
124 
125 end

源码 SHA-256：fd6d940f19d329bab386f23b090ec1ae4539ca73a4c57d6234045eff5dcf1130

  1 import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Constructions
  2 
  3 /-! # Right Hilbert C⋆-module foundations
  4 
  5 We use `CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E`: the right action `x b` is `MulOpposite.op b • x`,
  6 and the usual B-valued inner product is `MulOpposite.unop (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y)`.
  7 This explicit opposite is necessary because the pinned Mathlib convention has
  8 `inner x (a • y) = a * inner x y`. Completeness is an additional
  9 `CompleteSpace E` assumption when a Hilbert (rather than pre-Hilbert) module
 10 is required. The results below also hold before completion and for nonunital B.
 11 -/
 12 
 13 noncomputable section
 14 namespace BC4lean.KKTheory
 15 
 16 open scoped InnerProductSpace
 17 open CStarModule
 18 
 19 variable {B E : Type*} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B]
 20   [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
 21 
 22 /-- Nondegeneracy in the first variable. -/
 23 theorem module_inner_ext_left {x y : E} GitHub source
 24     (h : ∀ z, ⟪x, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)) : x = y := by
 25   apply sub_eq_zero.mp
 26   apply (CStarModule.inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)).mp
 27   rw [CStarModule.inner_sub_left, h, sub_self]
 28 
 29 /-- Nondegeneracy in the second variable. -/
 30 theorem module_inner_ext_right {x y : E} GitHub source
 31     (h : ∀ z, ⟪z, x⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪z, y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)) : x = y := by
 32   apply module_inner_ext_left (B := B)
 33   intro z
 34   simpa only [CStarModule.star_inner] using congrArg star (h z)
 35 
 36 /-- The scalar action distributes over addition in the coefficient algebra. -/
 37 theorem module_add_smul (a b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) : (a + b) • x = a • x + b • x := by GitHub source
 38   apply module_inner_ext_right (B := B)
 39   intro z
 40   simp only [inner_op_smul_right, CStarModule.inner_add_right, add_mul]
 41 
 42 /-- The scalar action distributes over addition in the module. -/
 43 theorem module_smul_add (a : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x y : E) : a • (x + y) = a • x + a • y := by GitHub source
 44   apply module_inner_ext_right (B := B)
 45   intro z
 46   simp only [inner_op_smul_right, CStarModule.inner_add_right, mul_add]
 47 
 48 /-- Associativity of the right action, expressed with opposite coefficients. -/
 49 theorem module_mul_smul (a b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) : (a * b) • x = a • (b • x) := by GitHub source
 50   apply module_inner_ext_right (B := B)
 51   intro z
 52   simp only [inner_op_smul_right, mul_assoc]
 53 
 54 /-- Compatibility of complex multiplication with the coefficient action. -/
 55 theorem module_complex_smul (c : ℂ) (a : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) : GitHub source
 56     (c • a) • x = c • (a • x) := by
 57   apply module_inner_ext_right (B := B)
 58   intro z
 59   simp only [inner_op_smul_right, inner_smul_right_complex, smul_mul_assoc]
 60 
 61 /-- The module action is contractive; no bound on it is assumed. -/
 62 theorem module_norm_smul_le (a : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) : ‖a • x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by GitHub source
 63   have h : ‖a • x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖a‖ * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
 64     calc
 65       ‖a • x‖ ^ 2 = ‖a * ⟪x, x⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) * star a‖ := by
 66         rw [CStarModule.norm_sq_eq (Bᵐᵒᵖ), inner_op_smul_right, inner_op_smul_left, ← mul_assoc]
 67       _ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖⟪x, x⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)‖ * ‖star a‖ := norm_mul₃_le
 68       _ = (‖a‖ * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
 69         rw [norm_star, ← CStarModule.norm_sq_eq (Bᵐᵒᵖ)]
 70         ring
 71   exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (_root_.norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)).mp h
 72 
 73 variable [StarOrderedRing B]
 74 
 75 /-- The standard right module over B has the usual B-valued inner product. -/
 76 theorem standard_module_inner (x y : B) : GitHub source
 77     MulOpposite.unop ⟪MulOpposite.op x, MulOpposite.op y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = star x * y := rfl
 78 
 79 omit [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B] in
 80 /-- The standard right module is complete. -/
 81 theorem standard_module_complete : CompleteSpace Bᵐᵒᵖ := inferInstance GitHub source
 82 
 83 end BC4lean.KKTheory
