源码 SHA-256：8fb98856ffd3521f889d54e0c04dd1dfe893c277b0891394e20c6d47ee36728d

  1 import BC4lean.HilbertCStarModule
  2 
  3 /-! # Adjointable maps of right Hilbert C⋆-modules
  4 
  5 An adjointable map is a bounded complex-linear map with a bounded adjoint for
  6 the coefficient-valued inner product. Module linearity is proved from the
  7 adjoint identity. Completeness is not needed for these algebraic identities.
  8 -/
  9 
 10 noncomputable section
 11 namespace BC4lean.KKTheory
 12 
 13 open scoped InnerProductSpace
 14 open CStarModule
 15 
 16 variable {B E F G H : Type*} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B]
 17   [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
 18   [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F]
 19   [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℂ G] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ G] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ G]
 20   [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ H] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ H]
 21 
 22 /-- A bounded adjointable map, storing its uniquely determined adjoint. -/
 23 structure AdjointableMap (B E F : Type*) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] GitHub source
 24     [PartialOrder B]
 25     [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
 26     [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F] where
 27   toCLM : E →L[ℂ] F
 28   adjointCLM : F →L[ℂ] E
 29   adjoint_identity : ∀ x y, ⟪toCLM x, y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪x, adjointCLM y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)
 30 
 31 namespace AdjointableMap
 32 
 33 instance instCoeFun : CoeFun (AdjointableMap B E F) (fun _ => E → F) := ⟨fun T => T.toCLM⟩
 34 
 35 /-- Uniqueness of an adjoint. -/
 36 theorem adjoint_unique (T : AdjointableMap B E F) (S : F →L[ℂ] E) GitHub source
 37     (hS : ∀ x y, ⟪T x, y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪x, S y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)) : S = T.adjointCLM := by
 38   ext y
 39   apply module_inner_ext_right (B := B)
 40   intro x
 41   rw [← hS, T.adjoint_identity]
 42 
 43 @[ext] theorem ext {S T : AdjointableMap B E F} (h : ∀ x, S x = T x) : S = T := by
 44   have hf : S.toCLM = T.toCLM := ContinuousLinearMap.ext h
 45   have ha : S.adjointCLM = T.adjointCLM := T.adjoint_unique S.adjointCLM (by
 46     intro x y
 47     rw [← h x]
 48     exact S.adjoint_identity x y)
 49   cases S
 50   cases T
 51   cases hf
 52   cases ha
 53   rfl
 54 
 55 /-- Every adjointable complex-linear map respects the right coefficient action. -/
 56 @[simp] theorem map_op_smul (T : AdjointableMap B E F) (a : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) : GitHub source
 57     T (a • x) = a • T x := by
 58   apply module_inner_ext_left (B := B)
 59   intro y
 60   rw [T.adjoint_identity, inner_op_smul_left, inner_op_smul_left, T.adjoint_identity]
 61 
 62 /-- The adjoint as an adjointable map in the reverse direction. -/
 63 def adjoint (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : AdjointableMap B F E where
 64   toCLM := T.adjointCLM
 65   adjointCLM := T.toCLM
 66   adjoint_identity x y := by
 67     simpa only [CStarModule.star_inner] using (congrArg star (T.adjoint_identity y x)).symm
 68 
 69 @[simp] theorem adjoint_adjoint (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : T.adjoint.adjoint = T := rfl GitHub source
 70 
 71 /-- Zero adjointable map. -/
 72 def zero : AdjointableMap B E F where
 73   toCLM := 0
 74   adjointCLM := 0
 75   adjoint_identity _ _ := by simp
 76 
 77 @[simp] theorem zero_apply (x : E) : (zero : AdjointableMap B E F) x = 0 := rfl
 78 
 79 @[simp] theorem adjoint_zero : (zero : AdjointableMap B E F).adjoint = zero := rfl
 80 
 81 /-- Identity adjointable operator. -/
 82 def id : AdjointableMap B E E where
 83   toCLM := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E
 84   adjointCLM := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ E
 85   adjoint_identity _ _ := rfl
 86 
 87 @[simp] theorem id_apply (x : E) : (id : AdjointableMap B E E) x = x := rfl
 88 
 89 @[simp] theorem adjoint_id : (id : AdjointableMap B E E).adjoint = id := rfl
 90 
 91 /-- Composition, with the adjoints in reverse order. -/
 92 def comp (S : AdjointableMap B F G) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : AdjointableMap B E G where
 93   toCLM := S.toCLM.comp T.toCLM
 94   adjointCLM := T.adjointCLM.comp S.adjointCLM
 95   adjoint_identity x y := by
 96     change ⟪S (T x), y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪x, T.adjointCLM (S.adjointCLM y)⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)
 97     rw [S.adjoint_identity, T.adjoint_identity]
 98 
 99 @[simp] theorem comp_apply (S : AdjointableMap B F G) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) (x : E) :
100     S.comp T x = S (T x) := rfl
101 
102 @[simp] theorem adjoint_comp (S : AdjointableMap B F G) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : GitHub source
103     (S.comp T).adjoint = T.adjoint.comp S.adjoint := rfl
104 
105 @[simp] theorem id_comp (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : id.comp T = T := by ext; rfl GitHub source
106 
107 @[simp] theorem comp_id (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : T.comp id = T := by ext; rfl GitHub source
108 
109 theorem comp_assoc (R : AdjointableMap B G H) (S : AdjointableMap B F G) GitHub source
110     (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : (R.comp S).comp T = R.comp (S.comp T) := by ext; rfl
111 
112 /-- Sum of adjointable maps. -/
113 def add (S T : AdjointableMap B E F) : AdjointableMap B E F where
114   toCLM := S.toCLM + T.toCLM
115   adjointCLM := S.adjointCLM + T.adjointCLM
116   adjoint_identity x y := by
117     change ⟪S x + T x, y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪x, S.adjointCLM y + T.adjointCLM y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)
118     rw [CStarModule.inner_add_left, CStarModule.inner_add_right, S.adjoint_identity, T.adjoint_identity]
119 
120 @[simp] theorem add_apply (S T : AdjointableMap B E F) (x : E) :
121     S.add T x = S x + T x := rfl
122 
123 @[simp] theorem adjoint_add (S T : AdjointableMap B E F) : GitHub source
124     (S.add T).adjoint = S.adjoint.add T.adjoint := rfl
125 
126 /-- Complex scalar multiplication; the adjoint is conjugate-linear. -/
127 def smul (c : ℂ) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : AdjointableMap B E F where
128   toCLM := c • T.toCLM
129   adjointCLM := star c • T.adjointCLM
130   adjoint_identity x y := by
131     change ⟪c • T x, y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪x, star c • T.adjointCLM y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)
132     rw [inner_smul_left_complex, inner_smul_right_complex, T.adjoint_identity]
133 
134 @[simp] theorem smul_apply (c : ℂ) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) (x : E) :
135     T.smul c x = c • T x := rfl
136 
137 @[simp] theorem adjoint_smul (c : ℂ) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : GitHub source
138     (T.smul c).adjoint = T.adjoint.smul (star c) := by ext; rfl
139 
140 end AdjointableMap
141 end BC4lean.KKTheory

RankOneOperator.lean

源码 SHA-256：d3b1c87e56a885b902f6f431a74d8b606c1ae0ec42f22a1520a3c08c92ea2675

  1 import BC4lean.AdjointableOperator
  2 
  3 /-! # Rank-one operators on right Hilbert C⋆-modules
  4 
  5 For x in F and y in E, θ(x,y) maps z to x⟨y,z⟩. We prove boundedness,
  6 adjointability and the composition identities used to construct compact module
  7 operators. Operator-norm closure and the compact-operator ideal are later work.
  8 -/
  9 
 10 noncomputable section
 11 namespace BC4lean.KKTheory
 12 
 13 open scoped InnerProductSpace
 14 open CStarModule
 15 
 16 variable {B E F G : Type*} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder B] [StarOrderedRing B]
 17   [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
 18   [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F]
 19   [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℂ G] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ G] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ G]
 20 
 21 /-- The rank-one map as a bounded complex-linear map. -/
 22 def moduleRankOneCLM (x : F) (y : E) : E →L[ℂ] F := GitHub source
 23   LinearMap.mkContinuous
 24     { toFun := fun z => ⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x
 25       map_add' := fun z w => by rw [CStarModule.inner_add_right, module_add_smul]
 26       map_smul' := fun c z => by
 27         simp only [inner_smul_right_complex, module_complex_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
 28     (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) (fun z => by
 29       calc
 30         ‖⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x‖ ≤ ‖⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)‖ * ‖x‖ := module_norm_smul_le _ _
 31         _ ≤ (‖y‖ * ‖z‖) * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (CStarModule.norm_inner_le E) (_root_.norm_nonneg _)
 32         _ = (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * ‖z‖ := by ring)
 33 
 34 @[simp] theorem moduleRankOneCLM_apply (x : F) (y z : E) :
 35     moduleRankOneCLM (B := B) x y z = ⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x := rfl
 36 
 37 /-- A rank-one map is adjointable, with θ(x,y)* = θ(y,x). -/
 38 def moduleRankOne (x : F) (y : E) : AdjointableMap B E F where GitHub source
 39   toCLM := moduleRankOneCLM (B := B) x y
 40   adjointCLM := moduleRankOneCLM (B := B) y x
 41   adjoint_identity z w := by
 42     change ⟪⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x, w⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) = ⟪z, ⟪x, w⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • y⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)
 43     simp only [inner_op_smul_left, inner_op_smul_right, CStarModule.star_inner]
 44 
 45 @[simp] theorem moduleRankOne_apply (x : F) (y z : E) :
 46     moduleRankOne (B := B) x y z = ⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x := rfl
 47 
 48 @[simp] theorem moduleRankOne_adjoint (x : F) (y : E) : GitHub source
 49     (moduleRankOne (B := B) x y).adjoint = moduleRankOne y x := rfl
 50 
 51 /-- The usual rank-one operator-norm bound. -/
 52 theorem moduleRankOne_norm_le (x : F) (y : E) : GitHub source
 53     ‖(moduleRankOne (B := B) x y).toCLM‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := by
 54   apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
 55   intro z
 56   change ‖⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x‖ ≤ _
 57   calc
 58     _ ≤ ‖⟪y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ)‖ * ‖x‖ := module_norm_smul_le _ _
 59     _ ≤ (‖y‖ * ‖z‖) * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (CStarModule.norm_inner_le E) (_root_.norm_nonneg _)
 60     _ = (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * ‖z‖ := by ring
 61 
 62 /-- Left composition by an adjointable map preserves rank-one operators. -/
 63 theorem comp_moduleRankOne (T : AdjointableMap B F G) (x : F) (y : E) : GitHub source
 64     T.comp (moduleRankOne x y) = moduleRankOne (T x) y := by
 65   ext z
 66   exact T.map_op_smul _ _
 67 
 68 /-- Right composition by an adjointable map preserves rank-one operators. -/
 69 theorem moduleRankOne_comp (x : G) (y : F) (T : AdjointableMap B E F) : GitHub source
 70     (moduleRankOne x y).comp T = moduleRankOne x (T.adjoint y) := by
 71   ext z
 72   change ⟪y, T z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x = ⟪T.adjoint y, z⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x
 73   rw [T.adjoint.adjoint_identity]
 74   rfl
 75 
 76 /-- Product of two rank-one operators. -/
 77 theorem moduleRankOne_comp_moduleRankOne (x : G) (y u : F) (v : E) : GitHub source
 78     (moduleRankOne (B := B) x y).comp (moduleRankOne u v) =
 79       moduleRankOne (⟪y, u⟫_(Bᵐᵒᵖ) • x) v :=
 80   comp_moduleRankOne _ _ _
 81 
 82 /-- On the standard right module, θ(x,y) is left multiplication by x y*. -/
 83 theorem standard_moduleRankOne (x y z : B) : GitHub source
 84     MulOpposite.unop (moduleRankOne (B := B) (MulOpposite.op x)
 85       (MulOpposite.op y) (MulOpposite.op z)) = x * star y * z := by
 86   change x * (star y * z) = x * star y * z
 87   rw [mul_assoc]
 88 
 89 end BC4lean.KKTheory
